text: Maasdam is a washed-curd Dutch cheese to which propionic acid bacteria are added; during a warm-room stage they multiply and ferment lactate to CO2, propionate and acetate, giving large round eyes and a sweet, nutty taste. Its low salt, high moisture and warm ripening make it prone to butyric spoilage, so the milk is often centrifuged to remove spores.
